## Purpose

Template for a working document whose tables and figures are regenerated from committed run results (`paper1/results/`). Copy it, rename it, edit the text. Render with `scripts\render_doc.ps1 Docs\<file>.qmd`, or use the Quarto preview button in VS Code.

## Total system cost across the 9 canonical runs

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

root = Path.cwd()
while not (root / "paper1" / "results").exists():
    root = root.parent

rows = []
for d in sorted((root / "paper1" / "results").iterdir()):
    f = d / "TotalCost.csv"
    if f.exists():
        scen, case = d.name.split("__")
        cost = pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0).loc["TotalCost"].iloc[0]
        rows.append({"forest": scen, "case": case, "total_cost": cost})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
tab = df.pivot(index="forest", columns="case", values="total_cost")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))
tab.plot.bar(ax=ax)
ax.set_ylabel("Total cost (model units, see run_metadata.json)")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.legend(title="GHG case")
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
tab.round(0)
```
